request.reason: Complete the owner-provided user benefit in the supported structured intent fields and declare the six mandatory preflight projections for this Work Item. Keep the approved two-file implementation boundary, acceptance criteria, verification checks, and all gate safety requirements unchanged.

value.businessGoal: Keep the governance integrity and Work Item status consistency gates aligned on the same valid superseded-predecessor lineage.
constraints: Change only the governance integrity gate and its regression test as implementation files.
Require valid digest-bound supersede recovery, predecessor close, repository identity, and exact successor lineage before the Recovered projection is accepted.
Keep successor verification, archive, acceptance, and close requirements unchanged.
nonGoals: Do not change AI Cockpit Runtime binaries or libraries.
Do not change release workflow, publication, tags, or provider resources.
value.problem: For the same valid lineage, the governance integrity gate rejects the predecessor's Recovered projection while status consistency accepts it; the successor must remain unfinished.
value.rationale: The repair makes both gates agree on the predecessor's valid recovered status without representing an unfinished successor as terminal.
value.userGoal: Repository maintainers can record a legally superseded predecessor as Recovered in all three parity ledgers while the unfinished successor remains visibly awaiting_successor_close.

changes.value: The governance integrity gate and Work Item status consistency gate classify the same valid superseded-predecessor lineage differently. The predecessor should project as Recovered only with strict recovery, close, repository, and successor bindings; its unfinished successor must remain awaiting_successor_close.

acceptanceCriteria: A valid digest-bound supersede recovery, valid predecessor close, matching repository and predecessor lineage, and exact successor Contract/Summary binding allow Recovered in all three parity ledgers while inventory remains awaiting_successor_close and the successor remains active and unverified.
In progress remains accepted for valid unfinished successor lineage; only a verified, archived, confirmed-closed successor resolves the predecessor to Implemented.

Wrong recovery digest, wrong repository, wrong successor, wrong predecessor lineage, missing or invalid predecessor close, or a merely awaiting_successor_close state without the exact supersede proof cannot use the Recovered exception.
Negative fixtures prove an unfinished successor cannot be projected as terminal, and existing acceptance, archive, and close requirements remain unchanged.
The clean six-document WI-1068 snapshot passes both governance integrity and Work Item status consistency after the gate correction.
